consequence.statement: Bug fix: Windows pod launch no longer fails when the instance type isn't in the vpc resource controller config; no operator action is stated.

original.statement: A bug fix: launching a Windows pod no longer fails when the instance type isn't in the vpc resource controller config.

decision.reason: [ev-664e993932dd] lists this under Bug Fixes. It says only that Windows pods no longer fail to launch when the instance type isn't in the vpc resource controller config. Nothing in the evidence says anything fails, is rejected or stops being honoured after the upgrade, and no operator step is stated. The only effect is that a previously broken launch now works, so "none" (informational) fits better than a failure kind. Calling it behavior-change, as P1 and P4 did, would ask operators to review a plain repair.
